findings.text: The old awk check always succeeded, so it never rejected anything. The new check really enforces the regex, and the allowed character class has no ':', '~', '%', '+', '@' or '?'. A valid mirror such as NVM_NODEJS_ORG_MIRROR=http://localhost:8080/dist, or an internal mirror with a port or userinfo, now fails with 'may only contain a URL' and return 2, so nvm install and nvm ls-remote break for users who relied on it.
